concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-authorization-tokenization-key-ios-v7]] - iOS v7 website guide to static, reduced-privilege tokenization-key authorization and its environment, lifecycle, capability, and historical certificate boundaries
warnings: This website snapshot does not establish current iOS v7 support or parity with the independently retained GitHub implementation baseline.
Tokenization-key client authorization is distinct from Braintree Auth merchant OAuth and from transaction authorization.
The captured page's any-version SDK statement is in tension with its dated certificate-expiry warning for older mobile SDK versions.
